# `vox-drift-check`

**Crate:** `vox-drift-check` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Workspace-wide multi-language drift and pattern-repetition linter

## Crate Overview

Workspace-wide multi-language drift and pattern-repetition linter.

Detects stale symbol references, naming drift, copy-paste drift, stale patterns,
and diverging implementations across Rust, TypeScript, Vox source files, and the monorepo.


## Features

| Feature | Default / Enables |
|---|---|
| `drift-typescript` | dep:swc_ecma_parser, dep:swc_ecma_ast, dep:swc_ecma_visit, dep:swc_common |

That supports both trailing-comment style:  ```ignore Duration::from_secs(5);          // drift-allow(timeout-literal): rationale ```  and the comment-above style:  ```ignore // drift-allow(timeout-literal): rationale Duration::from_secs(5); ```  Rule IDs may be slash-segmented (`drift/timeout-literal`) or short-form (`timeout-literal`); both forms get stored verbatim.
